# anthropic_spend_limit (Resource)

Manages a spend limit (`/v1/organizations/spend_limits`). Set exactly one scope: `user_id` (Claude Enterprise), `workspace_id` or `organization = true` (Claude Console). Set either `amount` in cents or `unlimited = true`. Workspace and organization limits are early access, monthly and always capped. The Default workspace cannot have one. Creating a workspace or organization limit fails if one already exists for that scope and period. Import it instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Capped monthly spend limit ($150.00 = "15000" cents)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "engineer_monthly_cap" {
  user_id = "user_01J9ABCDEF"
  period  = "monthly"
  amount  = "15000"
}

# Explicit unlimited monthly spend override ("amount": null in the Anthropic API)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "principal_unlimited" {
  user_id   = "user_01J9XYZ123"
  period    = "monthly"
  unlimited = true
}

# Claude Console workspace spend limit (early access, monthly only, always capped)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "team_workspace" {
  workspace_id = "wrkspc_01EXAMPLE"
  amount       = "50000"
}

# Claude Console organization-wide spend limit (early access)
resource "anthropic_spend_limit" "organization" {
  organization = true
  amount       = "100000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `amount` (String) Spend cap in minor currency units (cents) as a string, for example `"10000"` for $100.00 or `"0"` for $0.00. Mutually exclusive with `unlimited = true`.
- `organization` (Boolean) Set to `true` for the Claude Console organization-wide spend limit (early access).
- `period` (String) Window the limit resets over: `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly` (default). Workspace and organization limits must be `monthly`.
- `unlimited` (Boolean) Set to `true` for an unlimited spend override. Mutually exclusive with `amount`.
- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the organization user to whom this spend limit applies (Claude Enterprise). Exactly one of `user_id`, `workspace_id`, or `organization` must be set.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the Claude Console workspace to which this spend limit applies (early access).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the spend limit was created.
- `currency` (String) ISO 4217 currency code returned by the API (e.g., `USD`).
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the spend limit (`spl_...`).
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) `false` when extra usage is switched off for the organization (organization limit only). The amount is kept and applies again when switched back on. Always `true` for other scopes.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the spend limit was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Spend limits are imported by spend limit ID.
terraform import anthropic_spend_limit.team_workspace spl_01EXAMPLE
```
